crossRefs.note: Then I took the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:
“Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

translations.web: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
translations.bsb: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.
translations.kjv: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
translations.asv: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the roll.
